## Personality

Shearer is characterized by a pervasive sense of urgency. They are known to always be in a hurry, forcing others to rush to meet them regardless of their current state.

_Sources: [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P21](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0021)_

## History

Shearer is a local buyer whom [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) encounters after chasing a Jersey cow out of Mr. Harrison's oat field. Believing the animal to be her own stray cow, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) impulsively sells the cow to Shearer. He purchases the livestock from her before [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) subsequently realizes the mistake and discovers she sold her neighbor's property.

_Sources: [v2 II Selling in Haste and Repenting at Leisure P1](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0001), [v2 II Selling in Haste and Repenting at Leisure P2](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0002), [v2 II Selling in Haste and Repenting at Leisure P5](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0005), [v2 II Selling in Haste and Repenting at Leisure P6](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0006), [v2 II Selling in Haste and Repenting at Leisure P7](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0007), [v2 II Selling in Haste and Repenting at Leisure P14](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0014), +18 more_
